title: What stock does AI get completely wrong?
author: TradeHints
selftext:
I keep seeing AI investing tools give confident answers on stocks where the actual story is way more complicated.

What ticker do you think is the best example, and what would an automated model miss?

I built a free stock-analysis tool called TradeHints, so I’m going to run some of the names people mention and see where it agrees or completely falls apart.

[https://tradehints.com](https://tradehints.com)
